notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 45-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.59, bnp 1679, creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 15.1, platelets 303, sodium 140, wbc 9.7; vitals dbp 64-69, heart_rate 80-85, map 84-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 119-126, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 30%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 15, platelets 302, sodium 140, wbc 9.4; vitals dbp 65-70, heart_rate 80-86, map 84-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 120-127, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
